pages.name: Sicilian: O'Kelly, 3.c3 d5
pages.notes: Plan 2 recaptured with ...Qxd5 before White has taken on d5; plan 3 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 2-3; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: O'Kelly, 3.c3 e6
pages.notes: Plan 4 pushed f4-f5 through the f3-knight; plan 2 gave White an isolated pawn without the exchanges that create one; plan 3 wrote ...0-0. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Nimzowitsch Variation, Closed Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 through the f3-knight. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Nimzowitsch, 3.Nc3 d5 4.exd5
pages.notes: Plan 1 challenged a knight on d5 that has not yet recaptured there. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Nimzowitsch, 4.Nc3 e6 5.Nxd5
pages.notes: Plan 2 used ...Qe7 to control e4 and missed that ...exd5 must come first. Rewrote plan 2. Plan 1 (pressure on a d5-pawn not yet there, a c-file) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-12 (reviewer: first draft's development did not bear on d5).

pages.name: Sicilian: Nimzowitsch, Rubinstein Countergambit, 7.dxc5
pages.notes: Overview said White gains the development lead (it is Black's, for the pawn); plan 2 named e4 and c4 as moves. Rewrote overview and plan 2 around 7...Bxc5 8.Qxd5 Qb6; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Closed, Anti-Sveshnikov Variation, Kharlov-Kramnik Line
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 traded the g5-bishop for a knight on f3 that has gone to d2; plan 1 wrote the knight route as f1-g3; plan 4 developed a 'queenside knight' already on c6. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2, 4; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Closed, Anti-Sveshnikov Variation, with d6
pages.notes: Plan 1 played a3 to stop ...Bb4, which the d6-pawn already blocks; plan 4 routed the knight f6-e8-g7; overview called it a reversed King's Indian. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Nyezhmetdinov-Rossolimo Attack
pages.notes: Plan 4 'broke the pin' when Bb5 pins nothing; plan 1-2 wrote the exchanges so they could not be read; plan 3 wrote 0-0. Rewrote all four plans; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Nyezhmetdinov-Rossolimo Attack, Brooklyn Retreat Defense
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...b5 with White's bishop on b5. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, Grand Prix, 3...g6 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.Bb5 Nd4 6.O-O
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-9: plan 3 kept a pin that isn't one. Rewrote plan 3 (reviewer: first draft retreated the bishop to d3 and then played d3).

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, 6.f4 e5 7.Nf3 Nge7
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-9: plan 2 offered a ...d6-d5 break. Rewrote plan 2 (reviewer: first draft said both knights control d4).
